messages.subject: cfa error message
parts:
Hello All.
I am trying to run a CFA in R studio but am getting this message
> model1 <- 'techuse=~TechSim1+CkSMDay1+SkNwAps1+TechLei1+UpgrdPh1'
> fit1 <- cfa(model1, data - dat)
Error: could not find function "cfa"

Does anyone have any idea about how I might move past this.

messages.author: 0325c6a976085eab

parts:

Run:

library(lavaan)
first.

If that gives an error, run:

install.packages("lavaan")

first. (Notice no quotes in first, quotes in second.)

Jeremy

You have a typo.

Not

But

Assuming dat is the name of your data.

You ask
Can I move forward with these numbers or do I have to redesign my survey?

That's probably a better question for SEMNet than the lavaan mailing list, but I am sure you'll get some responses. Here's what I think.

You reject the chi-square test, your CFI is low, your RMSEA is high, not sure what your SRMR is as it's not included. What do you correlation residuals look?

I am guessing you have some large values. And as Jeremy noted you have an N of 78 and 49 free parameters, you're estimating a lot, with a little.
